svg.title: For every technology, the share of large enterprises using it is higher than that of small ones
svg.desc: Slope chart: For every technology, the share of large enterprises using it is higher than that of small ones: 10–49 staff: Text mining: 9.9%, Speech recognition: 5.9%, Text/code generation: 7.0%, Image recognition: 3.0%, Machine learning: 3.8%, Workflow automation: 4.1%, Image/audio generation: 8.1%; 250+ staff: Text mining: 35.0%, Speech recognition: 26.1%, Text/code generation: 31.7%, Image recognition: 16.7%, Machine learning: 25.1%, Workflow automation: 24.4%, Image/audio generation: 27.9%.
